name: Span Space Isosurface Extraction
aliases: Near Optimal Isosurface Extraction Algorithm using the Span Space
definition: An isosurface extraction algorithm that uses a 'span space' representation of the dataset to achieve a worst-case search complexity of O(√n + k), where n is the dataset size and k is the number of cells in the isosurface. It solves the problem of rapidly locating cells intersecting an isosurface in large datasets.
summary: Span Space Isosurface Extraction rapidly identifies intersecting volume cells by mapping scalar extrema to a 2D plane, distinguishing itself by leveraging geometric properties rather than hierarchical spatial subdivision.
